text.description_html:
First Impressions 2 Inch Crystal Shower Door Knob Set

These sparkling large 2" diameter crystal shower door knobs are easy to grab and compliment a bold designed bathroom. Made of imported 24% lead crystal with high quality brass mounting bases for long life.

Available with antique brass, bright polished chrome or satin nickel finish. The extra large crystal knobs have lots of facets that produce a gleaming color array.

Specifications: for First Impressions Crystal Shower Door Knob Set

  • Knob Diameter: 2"
  • Material: 24% Lead Crystal / Solid Brass

Packaged with 2 crystal knobs and includes all the hardware for back to back mounting (knobs hook to each other) on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors, with either a 3/8" or 1/2" diameter hole in the glass.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Crystal Knobs - 1 knob for each side of the glass)
